summary: First-finish smoke test for Reverend Insanity reader. Backend (5 endpoints) and frontend core flows (landing, TOC, reader, keyboard shortcuts, settings, bookmarks with LocalStorage) all pass.
passed: GET /api/novel -> 200, title=Reverend Insanity, author=Gu Zhen Ren, total_chapters=2335, total_words=4870621
GET /api/chapters?limit=10&offset=0 -> 200, total=2335, items[] returns id/index/title/word_count (uses key 'items' not 'chapters')
GET /api/chapters/ch0002 -> 200, title='Chapter 1', paragraphs=91, prev=ch0001, next=ch0003, total=2335
Landing page loads with 2,335 stats and navigation buttons (browse-toc-btn)
TOC page loads with chapter-search-input and filter buttons; navigable from landing
Reader /read/ch0002 loads: title 'Chapter 1', 91 paragraphs, progress bar present, bookmark/settings buttons present
Keyboard 'b' toggles bookmark (verified: bookmark entry appears on /bookmarks page with note textarea)
Keyboard '?' opens shortcuts modal (Keyboard text found)
Keyboard 'j' navigates from ch0002 to ch0003
Settings panel opens; theme-selector-sepia, font-size-increase, width-selector-wide all clickable
Bookmarks page renders bookmarked Chapter 1 with note textarea and remove button (LocalStorage persistence verified across page navigation)
notes: Backend chapters endpoint returns 'items' key (not 'chapters'); frontend already handles this correctly.
TOC uses data-testid 'chapter-item-<id>' (chapterListItem) rather than 'chapter-card-<id>'; both are defined in testIds.js — not a bug.
Some page text uses CSS text-transform: uppercase, so raw inner_text substring checks for mixed-case strings may show False despite text being present visually (verified by screenshot).
